rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to any MCP server via URL and endpoint parameters, performs a connectivity check, then systematically retrieves and displays all available prompts, resources, resource templates, and tools in an organized format. Built with the fastmcp library, it provides a quick way to understand the full scope of functionality exposed by an MCP server without requiring manual JSON-RPC payload construction. Useful for security assessments, capability auditing, and development workflows where understanding a server's attack surface or API contract is needed.
